title: Plan a Reading Meeting

source.rights: 原创 AI 辅助虚构教学材料；尚待独立教学与发音审核。

instructions: Write your own response. The example is for study and is not a submission.
prompt: Write 120–180 words to a new member about a fictional reading meeting. Explain how to choose and borrow a book, give one deadline and one continuous time period, and suggest how to make the room comfortable. Use at least six lesson words.

guidedOutput.title: 写作结构提示
guidedOutput.text: 先说明活动与参加对象；再按顺序写选书、借书和两个不同时间；最后说明阅读时如何照顾其他人。使用 by、until 或 while，并检查不少于六个本课词。

reference: Our fictional reading group will meet next Wednesday at the town library. Please register by Monday so that the volunteer can prepare enough chairs. Your membership lets you borrow one book for the meeting, and the book is due the next week. You can use the catalogue to locate a paperback in any genre you enjoy. I might choose a mystery because I like a good plot, while my friend wants a biography. We do not need to finish the whole story before we meet. The room stays open until seven, so we can read a short part and then talk. To keep the noise low, please whisper if another reader is speaking. If you prefer poetry or a translation, ask the desk for suggestions. I hope the meeting will help every new reader feel welcome.
referenceLabel: 原创示例，仅供学习；不要作为自己的待提交作文。
